v1.baseline_description: Iterates through the entire flowerbed counting plantable spots without early stopping.
v1.refactoring_description: Terminates the loop early as soon as count reaches n (G3 - Early termination).

v2.baseline_description: Traverses the flowerbed with a while loop to find all plantable spots without early exit.
v2.refactoring_description: Terminates the while loop early as soon as plantable reaches n (G3 - Early termination).

v3.baseline_description: Iterates through the entire array simulating flower placement without early exit.
v3.refactoring_description: Returns True immediately inside the loop once n reaches 0 (G3 - Early termination).

v1.baseline_description: Two-pointer search without breaking early when the fixed anchor element is positive.
v1.refactoring_description: Breaks outer loop early when nums[i] > 0 since sorted numbers cannot sum to zero (G3 - Loop optimization).

v2.baseline_description: Two-pointer search continuing across all indices without early positive-anchor exit.
v2.refactoring_description: Adds early break when the fixed anchor exceeds zero (G3 - Loop optimization).

v3.baseline_description: Two-pointer search iterating through all elements without early termination.
v3.refactoring_description: Breaks outer loop early when nums[i] > 0 and skips duplicate values (G3 - Loop optimization).

v1.baseline_description: Converts magazine into a full list and mutates it with remove(), creating unnecessary list memory.
v1.refactoring_description: Compares character frequencies directly using set(ransomNote) and count() without allocating a list (G6 - Avoid storing unnecessary data).

v2.baseline_description: Constructs two separate defaultdict(int) frequency hash tables for both magazine and ransomNote.
v2.refactoring_description: Builds only a single frequency map for magazine and decrements in-place, eliminating the second dictionary (G6 - Avoid storing unnecessary data).

v3.baseline_description: Allocates two separate 26-element integer arrays to count letter frequencies for both strings.
v3.refactoring_description: Allocates a single 26-element array for magazine counts and decrements counts for ransomNote (G6 - Avoid storing unnecessary data).
